definitions.explanation: A machine part that supports a rotating shaft and reduces friction so that it can turn smoothly. The native Japanese term for ベアリング.

examples.japanese: {軸|じく}{受|う}けが{摩耗|まもう}する。
この{機械|きかい}は{軸|じく}{受|う}けの{交換|こうかん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: This machine needs its bearings replaced.

examples.japanese: {軸|じく}{受|う}けに{注油|ちゅうゆ}すると、{回転|かいてん}が{滑|なめ}らかになる。
examples.english: Oiling the bearing makes the rotation smoother.

notes:
The native Japanese term for ベアリング (from English "bearing"). Common in mechanical engineering and manufacturing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玉|たま}{軸|じく}{受|う}け: ball bearing
- {軸|じく}{受|う}けの{交換|こうかん}: bearing replacement
- {軸|じく}{受|う}けが{摩耗|まもう}する: the bearing wears out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ベアリング: bearing — the more common loanword, used interchangeably in everyday technical speech
